newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shrs fall at the open, huge volume.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shrs fall at the open, huge volume.

text.p: Shares in avidly watched Bre-X Minerals Ltd traded lower on the Toronto Stock Exchange at the open on Wednesday in phenomenal volume, then recovered and posted gains.
Bre-X was down 0.31 to 3.54 in turnover of more than one million shares in the first minute of action. Within five minutes, the stock was up 0.10 to 3.95 and volume topped 1.7 million shares.
Bre-X was halted in Toronto for all but 22 minutes on Tuesday after technical difficulaties forced the TSE to shut down trading in the frenetically traded stock.
